en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from one of our companions, from Aban, 
(It has been narrated) from Abdul Rahman, from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘One cannot sit between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa except from tiredness’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad, from certain persons of our people, from Aban, from ‘Abd al- Rahman who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
You must not sit down between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah unless you are very exhausted.’”
